Enumeration Type Documentation

enum participant_type_t

Participant type for distinguishing network vs memory participants. Server media state. The network runtime owns establishment, security, packet execution, and transport teardown. This state owns media buffers, capabilities, and the render workers joined by the connection closing hook.

Network participants communicate over TCP/IP or WebRTC, while memory participants inject media directly into the host's mixer (used when the host participates in the session with their own webcam/audio).
